r3_eliminate_runs — 2D region op

• Data kinds: region → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "r3_eliminate_runs", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: eliminate_runs (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Removes horizontal connected runs (sequences of consecutive foreground pixels) shorter than a specified length (equivalent to HALCON `eliminate_runs`).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a（0〜1）から最小ラン長 min_len = 1 + max(1, round(8*a)) を決め、これに満たない水平ランを除去する（a=0 で min_len=2、すなわち1 画素だけの細い橋を切る）。b` は未使用。走査は行ごと・水平方向のみ（縦方向のランは対象外）。
